Dr. Anuj Agnihotri has been declared the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 Topper, achieving the All India Rank 1 position in the highly competitive examination. The Civil Services Examination is an annual exam conducted by the Union Public Service Commission to recruit candidates into the prestigious All India Civil Services, including the Indian Administrative Service, Indian Foreign Service, Indian Police Service, etc.
The success story of IAS Topper 2025 Anuj Agnihotri has inspired thousands of students in the country. His success is the result of his determination, hard work, and academic credentials.

Who is Anuj Agnihotri?

Anuj Agnihotri is a medical professional who completed his MBBS course from AIIMS Jodhpur before pursuing his dream of joining the civil services. With a medical background and a high level of academic discipline, he prepared for the UPSC Civil Services Examination , which led to his achievement of the top rank in CSE 2025.
This achievement shows how a student from a different academic background can succeed in the civil services with a proper strategy.

Early Life and Background
Anuj Agnihotri belongs to Chittorgarh district in Rajasthan . From an early age, he showed strong academic potential and dedication toward his studies.

He completed his 10th standard from Atomic Energy Central School , where he developed a solid academic foundation. Later, he pursued his 12th standard from M.B. Public Senior Secondary School in Kota , a city widely known for its competitive academic environment.
His academic journey reflects consistent excellence and a strong commitment to learning .
Educational Background of Anuj Agnihotri
After completing school, Anuj qualified for medical studies and pursued MBBS from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Jodhpur , one of India’s premier medical institutions.
Studying at AIIMS exposed him to rigorous academic training and analytical thinking. However, despite having a promising career in medicine, Anuj chose a different path.
He decided to prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination , motivated by the desire to contribute to public administration and national development .
